YOUR SCENARIOILLUSTRATIVE FORECAST

Model assumptions & formulas

Reviewers supply 6 productive hours per working day. Expected rework = QA sample rate × baseline observed QA failure rate × 50% of handling time. Completion days are the greater of review days and QA days (parallel pipelines, 0.75 hours per sampled case, no QA rework). Required reviewers target 60 working days. Redress = population × uphold rate × mean recorded upheld redress. No new arrivals, absence, ramp-up, weekends or case dependencies are modelled. QA backlog compares demand with QA capacity over review duration. These are planning estimates, not committed dates.

AS IS → TO BE

Make the operating problem explicit.

From fragmented queues and retrospective MI to a shared view of stage pressure, harm themes and capacity trade-offs. Assumptions remain visible and decisions remain reviewable.

CONTROLS & EXCEPTIONS

Build the controls into the story.

Unique case IDs, reconciled totals, sampled-QA denominators and reproducible calculations. High redress, late cases and support needs prompt investigation, never automated adverse outcomes.

PORTFOLIO EVIDENCE

Operational experience, translated.

My complaints and remediation platform experience informs the problem framing: requirements, process mapping, operational MI, exception handling and a governed target operating model.

Data, limitations & methodology

10,000 fictional cases generated with seed 86. Fixed snapshot: 30 September 2026. All names, reviewers, teams, products and cases are synthetic. Relationships and anomalies are deliberately simulated and say nothing about any real firm or product. Recorded redress is allocated to upheld decisions; it does not imply money paid. Open undecided cases have no recorded redress. Network co-occurrence counts linked synthetic themes and does not prove causation. Heights are mean redress among upheld primary-cause cases. Vulnerability flag represents a fictional additional-support need, not a real person. The demo has no production integrations or access to customer data. An optional future LLM would receive controlled aggregate metrics server-side; this version sends no API requests to an AI provider.
